text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... Yes, I am. I didn't get
enough sleep.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Do you know what a spy pen is? They're
pens that
use ink that disappears a little
while after you
write something.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They're a really fun piece of spy tech,
but I
accidentally used one to do my
homework...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I spent so long rewriting it... Before I knew it, it was light outside... Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Aston Machan didn't get
much rest.
